records.name: Most Regret in a Season
records.definition: The most PAR that a manager's dropped players produced for other managers in one season.

records.name: Most Shotguns in a Season (League)
records.definition: A score of 0 or less from a non-defense starter who was not ruled out before the 2nd half, or ruled out but didn't play in the 2nd half.
records.engine_gap: Needs per-player points plus game-day inactive/ruled-out status for every starter.

records.name: Costliest Sit/Start Miss
records.holder: Aidan — sat Dallas Goedert; Aidan — sat Emanuel Wilson
records.definition: Started a player who scored below replacement while a bench player eligible for the same slot scored above replacement, and the call was a clear miss by pre-game projections. Points lost = the bench player's points minus the starter's.

records.name: Best Sit/Start Call
records.definition: A 'big-brain start': started the lower-projected player by 2+ points and won the swap. Points gained = the starter's points minus the benched player's.

records.name: Worst Lineup Week (Points Lost)
records.definition: The most points left on the bench in one week from clear lineup misses.

records.name: Most Points Lost to Lineup Misses in a Season
records.definition: Season total of points lost to clear lineup misses.

records.name: Most Wins Lost to Lineup Misses in a Season
records.definition: Losses that the week's clear misses were bigger than the margin of.

records.name: Most Rumbles Lost to Lineup Misses in a Season
records.definition: Rumbles that would have been earned with the right calls.

records.name: Most Big-Brain Calls in a Season
records.definition: Most winning sit/start calls (started the lower projection and won the swap) in one season.
